body.name: Exact rational one-collision benchmark
body.construction: Use the fully specified rational vectors \(\psi^{\diamond}\) and \(\psi^{\diamond,\mathrm{sw}}\) in the symbol table and set \(P^{\diamond}=F(\psi^{\diamond})=F(\psi^{\diamond,\mathrm{sw}})\). The control terminal row after state \(0\) is \((1/2,1/2)\), its row after state \(1\) is \((7/10,2/5)\), and both treated terminal rows are distinct.
